"""RGB camera comparison only; not service score or sheet state."""
import numpy as np, json
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates,distance_transform_edt,binary_erosion,label,shift
from scipy.signal import fftconvolve
from pathlib import Path
O=Path('/app/output')
im=np.array(Image.open(O/'main1_canvas_cam.png'));t=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100
v,u=np.mgrid[:1024,:1024];s=.227185/1024
vc=512+(v-511.5)*s*2344.588379/(.62-.0202);uc=512+(u-511.5)*s*2344.588379/(.62-.0202)
rgb=np.stack([map_coordinates(im[:,:,k].astype(float),[vc,uc],order=1)for k in range(3)],axis=-1).astype('uint8');Image.fromarray(rgb).save(O/'final.png');a=rgb[:,:,0]<110
# Find whole-pixel registration inside the allowed +/-5 mm window.
corr=fftconvolve(t.astype(float),a[::-1,::-1].astype(float),mode='full');w=corr[1001:1046,1001:1046];dy,dx=np.unravel_index(w.argmax(),w.shape);dy-=22;dx-=22
if abs(dy)==22 or abs(dx)==22:dy=dx=0
b=shift(a,(dy,dx),order=0);l,n=label(t);e1=t^binary_erosion(t);e2=b^binary_erosion(b);tol=1/.22186
p=(distance_transform_edt(~e1)[e2]<=tol).mean();r=(distance_transform_edt(~e2)[e1]<=tol).mean()
metrics={'source':'RGB estimate, not official score','iou':float((b&t).sum()/(b|t).sum()),'boundary_f':float(2*p*r/(p+r)),'stray_over_1mm':float((b&(distance_transform_edt(~t)>tol)).sum()/t.sum()),'connected_component_coverage':[float((b&(l==i)).sum()/(l==i).sum())for i in range(1,n+1)],'translation_pixels':[int(dx),int(dy)]}
print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2));(O/'camera_estimates.json').write_text(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2))
vis=np.full((1024,1024,3),240,dtype='uint8');vis[t]=[200,80,60];vis[b]=[50,110,190];vis[b&t]=[20,20,20];Image.fromarray(vis).save(O/'final_comparison.png');np.save(O/'final_mask.npy',a)
PY","max_output_tokens":1000}));
